en: {fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Don't worry about it. You came here for a reason, I assume.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Don't worry.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Hm. I suppose. I don't dislike it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting proper rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'm fine... ...Angels are a considerate sort, it seems.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Not bad.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Don't worry about me. I'm more at ease alone...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Yes. I suppose it is.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}What are you talking about?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...There's no need to fuss over me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...It has.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you come across any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Hm. I can't spare the time to take it in properly.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But there are places I've come to like.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did I startle you, showing up so suddenly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What are you talking about?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...As you see.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...I appreciate the thought. But there's nothing for now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}What nonsense are you talking?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you think makes traveling fun?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Visiting unknown lands and deepening my knowledge, I'd say.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is anything hard about traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}On a long journey, it's trouble if the horse falls ill.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is that all?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Meals are fun, aren't they?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I suppose...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}If that's all you came for, perhaps you are.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are there foods you don't like?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Not really.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever cook your own meals?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Simple things, yes.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm getting hungry too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Then go back and eat something.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is it different from the food at the castle?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not at all. The meals at the castle are plain too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you eat for your health?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Nothing in particular... I think it's best to eat everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you eat for your health?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Nothing in particular...{n}{e5:0080}{n}I think it's best to eat everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is something troubling you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Did it look that way? You worry too much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'm resting now. No need to be so careful.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not especially... I simply rest when I can.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look like you're having fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}If I can avoid fighting, so much the better.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did someone teach you that?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Taking rest is one of a knight's important duties too. It's something you pick up naturally.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there something you do every day?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Sword training.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever go out with the young knights?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Yes. To the kingdom's jousting tournaments and such.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'm resting now. No need to be so careful.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is that all?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're very dedicated, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...I don't intend to cut corners. That's all.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're working hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Half-hearted practice is meaningless.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Yes. I've only just begun.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What kind of training are you doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Building arm strength. Lance or sword, a weak arm is useless.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Why not rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}If you're only here to worry needlessly, then leave.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I should learn swordsmanship too, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Is that so? I don't really understand what an angel's role involves...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You swing your sword so gallantly.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}...Spare me the flattery. Battles aren't won on looks.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Somethin' else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Nah, it's fine. But quit bein' so stiff, y'know? It wears me out too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}You kiddin'? This much is nothin'.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sure. Every place gets you fired up in its own way.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Big talk, huh? For me it's just a stroll, really.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting proper rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}You don't gotta worry about that stuff. I ain't a kid anymore. I can look after myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not bad, but it ain't somethin' you gotta worry about. If it's bad, I'll handle it myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}That's what they call stickin' your nose in. I don't need you worryin' about me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah. Stay cooped up indoors all day and you'll rot.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Huh? Don't be stupid. Where'd you get that idea? You're a weird one.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Y'know, it's always the hungry one who asks that first.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Ain't you the one who's hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah. Guess so.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you come across any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Listen to you, all sunshine. Folks like you are what I call airheads.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did I startle you, showing up so suddenly?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}You always barge in outta nowhere. Why get polite about it now?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Nothin' much. Like you see, I'm just walkin'.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Oh yeah? Thanks. Then how 'bout helpin' me with a little theft?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Kiddin', just kiddin'.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Hey, hey, you got the wrong guy! That's somethin' you say to a kid!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How do you feel about becoming a hero?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Let's see... Mostly it's a pain in the neck.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}But when folks thank me, it kinda tickles. Ain't really like me...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you still working as a thief?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Yeah, got a problem with that? I do your jobs right. You got no business naggin' me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4780}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Huh? Don't be stupid. Where'd you get that idea? You're a weird one.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9780}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How do you feel about becoming a hero?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Let's see... Mostly it's a pain in the neck.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}But when folks thank me, it kinda tickles. Ain't really like me...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Somethin' else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Mind your own business. What I dream ain't none of yours.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Was I that much of a nuisance?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I don't think you're a nuisance. Just surprised me a little, showin' up so sudden.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was a little worried.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Well, aren't you the busy one. Too bad there's nothin' for you to worry about right now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you like staying up late?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Nope. I kinda like it, actually. Comes with bein' a thief, I guess.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Besides, partyin' all night ain't bad either. Not that you'd know, maybe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Let's do our best tomorrow too.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Geez... You're throwin' me off. That's what you say when you tuck a kid into bed.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is staying up late fun?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sounds like you're curious about stayin' up. An angel sayin' that... Honestly, I'm surprised.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}So you were here tonight.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thought I was out stealin'? Sorry, I'm closed today.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1F80}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you like staying up late?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Nope. I kinda like it, actually. Comes with bein' a thief, I guess.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Besides, partyin' all night ain't bad either. Not that you'd know, maybe.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}If there's more, spit it out.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Meals are fun, aren't they?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah. When you're eatin' somethin' good, it puts you in a happy mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Nah. Not really. If you're gonna worry about that, why come at all?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are there foods you don't like?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Nope, none. Bein' picky is for rich folks.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever cook your own meals?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hardly ever. Sooner than go to that trouble, I'd eat it raw or steal it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm getting hungry too.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}...Geez. At least eat your meals properly.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Ain't that what they call not lookin' after yourself?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Something smells good.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah? I'm stuffed, so spare me the smell for now.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Course, give it a while and I'll be hungry again.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look happy somehow.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}That so? Well, I finally got a decent meal for once.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What? Don't look so jealous. Wanna grab a bite with me sometime? I'll show you a good place.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}If there's more, don't be shy.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is something troubling you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Look... I'm about to go have a blast. Don't start with the heavy stuff now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I don't think you're in the way. I ain't in any big hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Do I look tired? ...Geez, sayin' that just when I'm about to have some fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look like you're having fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Sure I am. I'm about to go have a blast.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
